title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・いつもの2人

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet seizes victory at one of the greatest events in racing—the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She finally realizes that being number one means living forever in the hearts of all who watch her race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Next, she sets her sights on the Arima Kinen, where she vows she will become the number one Umamusume of all time.
